recent_reviews.title: 10/10 Recommend JoinFridays!
recent_reviews.body: JoinFridays has honestly been one of the best decisions I’ve made for my health. What I love most is that you’re not just getting access to medication you’re getting an entire support team behind you. The unlimited provider visits are amazing, and having access to dietitians, coaches, and additional support whenever I need it has made such a huge difference in my journey. Any time I’ve had questions or concerns, the team has been responsive, encouraging, and genuinely invested in my success. JoinFridays truly takes a whole-person approach to health, and it shows. They’re constantly rolling out new resources, tools, and ways to help members succeed, which makes me feel like I’m part of a company that actually cares about its patients. I’ve never felt more supported on a weight loss journey. If you’re looking for a telehealth company that goes above and beyond, I can’t recommend JoinFridays enough. I’m so grateful I found them and excited to continue my journey with them for years to come!

What I appreciate most is that the focus has been on creating sustainable habits rather than chasing quick fixes. The care team has been responsive whenever I’ve had questions, and I’ve felt comfortable reaching out for guidance. The program has helped me become more mindful about my nutrition, hydration, and overall wellness, and I’m excited to continue seeing progress. If you’re looking for a program that combines convenience, support, and accountability, Fridays has been a great option in my experience.

recent_reviews.title: I've been a Fridays patient for over 2.5 years!
recent_reviews.body: I've been a Fridays patient for over 2.5 years, and one of the things I appreciate most is how seen and heard I feel throughout my journey. The support has been exceptional from day one. Having unlimited access to registered dietitians and healthcare providers at no additional cost has been invaluable. Whenever I've had questions or needed guidance, someone has been there to help. I'm also incredibly impressed with the consistency of their medication fulfillment. In more than 2.5 years, my medications have always arrived on time—even through pharmacy changes and transitions. That level of reliability and care gives me so much confidence in the program. If you're looking for a team that truly supports you and treats you like a person, not just a patient, I highly recommend Fridays.

recent_reviews.title: Shipments stopped, payments continued with no explanation.
recent_reviews.body: All went smoothly with shipping and service for the first 5 months although I was feeling that the potency of solution might not be accurate and less concentrated than claimed. In the 4th month the shipping times got longer and longer and they still charged for another 3 months while the last dose had not been shipped for 3 weeks. I never received it 7 weeks in and with numerous phone calls and messages back and forth with them have never gotten an answer. I was able to reach out to my CC for fraud for the last charge but not able to recoup charge for last month paid for but not sent.
